exact_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Faithfully enhance ONLY the existing complete painted-game HAIR DIFFUSE UV TEXTURE. Image1 is the exact historical128x128 full originalRGBA; image2 is exactly the same full storedRGB enlarged only with nearest-neighbor. Keep entire square UV canvas and all source field boundaries, normalized positions, count, phase, source wave direction/spacing, hairline/part flow and scale. Fine resolve only existing soft painted hair shading, no new hairy geometry or clumps. This is a flat game material atlas, not a wig photograph, head portrait or new hairstyle. No skin, ears, eyes, nose, lips, teeth, head anatomy, ribbons, clips, new braid/curls, extra strands outside source fields or new parting. Original entire sourceA is restored separately; material/UV are unchanged. Source codec samples are paint/shading, never new physical blocks. Keep native black/dark backdrop and existing low-contrast local color/brightness hierarchy. No photographic fibers/pores, beautify, shiny gloss, white highlights, new grain/noise, relighting, brighter tips, extra ring/rim or hard edge. Entire output will be normalized to512x512. No crop/padding/rotation/repack/registration/individual-part enlargement or labels/comparison. Hair02: ONE connected soft brown/golden painted hair field with exactly TWO main left/right lobes divided by its existing narrow central descending dark parting. Upper crest remains near original y10; lower left rounded lobe and lower-right lobe retain reference size and source lower notch; surrounding whole black source canvas remains black. Preserve source sweeping wavy painted bands and source gentle muted warm-brown highlights, soft outer fade. No new volume, tight curls, new locks, sharper outline, separate objects or added wisps; no new light scalp stripe along part. Entire source alpha is255, black unused regions are RGB not a transparency silhouette.

reference_recipe.operations: Full sourceRGB nearest6 only, no crop/padding/registration/unpremultiply. Entire raw Lanczos512x512, authoritative whole originalA restored, pure scalar native brightness only.
